fields.name: frequency
fields.description: How often the voucher repeats. Object with unit (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR) and interval (every N units). Omit repeatOn when unit is DAY.

fields.name: repeatOn
fields.description: Calendar rule when frequency.unit is WEEK or MONTH. type: DAY_OF_MONTH | WEEK_DAYS | NTH_WEEKDAY | NTH_BUSINESS_DAY | EVERY_DAY. For DAY_OF_MONTH send dayOfMonth (1–31). For WEEK_DAYS send weekdays (MONDAY…SUNDAY). For NTH_WEEKDAY send nth (1–5) and weekday.

fields.name: end
fields.description: When recurrence stops. type: NEVER | AFTER_COUNT | ON_DATE. For AFTER_COUNT send count. For ON_DATE send endDate (dd-MM-yyyy). NEVER omits endDate.

fields.name: repeatOption
fields.description: UI preset that maps to frequency/repeatOn. Use CUSTOM when the user edits the schedule manually.

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: How often the voucher repeats. Object with unit (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR) and interval (every N units). Omit repeatOn when unit is DAY.

fields.name: repeatOn
fields.description: Calendar rule when frequency.unit is WEEK or MONTH. type: DAY_OF_MONTH | WEEK_DAYS | NTH_WEEKDAY | NTH_BUSINESS_DAY | EVERY_DAY. For DAY_OF_MONTH send dayOfMonth (1–31). For WEEK_DAYS send weekdays (MONDAY…SUNDAY). For NTH_WEEKDAY send nth (1–5) and weekday.

fields.name: end
fields.description: When recurrence stops. type: NEVER | AFTER_COUNT | ON_DATE. For AFTER_COUNT send count. For ON_DATE send endDate (dd-MM-yyyy). NEVER omits endDate.
